title: Git integration and landing
note: The merge audit reads a project-scoped registered snapshot over HTTPS or local dispatch, then checks Git branches, dirt and conflicts on the client. It refuses an unavailable snapshot with a named recovery; source proof does not establish deployed availability. The merge waits for the holding item up to merge_lock_ttl_minutes (default 30 minutes), acquires atomically when clear, and reports the holding item and recovery if the full wait times out. Release-pin-only target advances retry automatically up to twice while preserving unpublished local merges.
